        From 70998c5c67ddd08af458f0f29aa5830a0729a0c0 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Derek Bruening <bruening@google.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Mar 2018 01:05:48 -0500
Subject: [PATCH] i#975 static DR: fix Mac build (#2856)

Fixes a Mac build error introduced by 3bc33154.
Fixes a Mac test build error that shows up on newer toolchains.

Issue: #975
---
 core/unix/module.c                         | 2 +-
 suite/tests/client-interface/memval-test.c | 7 ++++---
 2 files changed, 5 insertions(+), 4 deletions(-)

diff --git a/core/unix/module.c b/core/unix/module.c
index 91865b744..e4c635e43 100644
--- a/core/unix/module.c
+++ b/core/unix/module.c
@@ -33,8 +33,8 @@
  */
 
 #include "../globals.h"
-#include "module_private.h"
 #include "../module_shared.h"
+#include "module_private.h"
 #include "os_private.h"
 #include "../utils.h"
 #include "instrument.h"
diff --git a/suite/tests/client-interface/memval-test.c b/suite/tests/client-interface/memval-test.c
index a71f043da..f5cffd684 100644
--- a/suite/tests/client-interface/memval-test.c
+++ b/suite/tests/client-interface/memval-test.c
@@ -1,5 +1,5 @@
 /* **********************************************************
- * Copyright (c) 2017 Google, Inc.  All rights reserved.
+ * Copyright (c) 2017-2018 Google, Inc.  All rights reserved.
  * **********************************************************/
 
 /*
@@ -90,9 +90,10 @@ GLOBAL_LABEL(FUNCNAME:)
         mov      REG_XDI, REG_XBP
         sub      REG_XDI, 12
         mov      [REG_XBP - 80], REG_XBP
-        jmp      test
+        /* We can't use "test" as a label on Mac NASM. */
+        jmp      test_start
 
-     test:
+     test_start:
         mov      REG_XCX, [REG_XDI + 12]
         mov      REG_XDX, [REG_XBP - 72]
         mov      REG_XBX, [REG_XBP - 80]
-- 
2.25.1


        
        Provide a response strictly in the following format:
        Root cause:<Root cause>

Root cause: The bug was caused by a build error on Mac systems, which resulted from the use of the label "test" in assembly code. Mac NASM does not allow the use of certain labels, leading to conflicts during the compilation of the test code. The patch resolved this issue by renaming the label "test" to "test_start", ensuring compatibility with Mac toolchains. Additionally, the inclusion of the header file `module_private.h` was reordered to maintain proper dependencies, which likely contributed to the original build error introduced by a previous commit.

    You will be given the root cause of a bug and  the corresponding patch.

    <text1>

Root cause:
The bug was caused by a build error on Mac systems, which resulted from the use of the label "test" in assembly code. Mac NASM does not allow the use of certain labels, leading to conflicts during the compilation of the test code. The patch resolved this issue by renaming the label "test" to "test_start", ensuring compatibility with Mac toolchains. Additionally, the inclusion of the header file `module_private.h` was reordered to maintain proper dependencies, which likely contributed to the original build error introduced by a previous commit.
